```gherkin
Feature: Alarms Threshold Settings

  Scenario: GUI has a control for setting the threshold for HIGH RR alarm
    Given the user is on the alarm settings page
    When the user clicks on the HIGH RR alarm threshold setting
    Then the threshold setting control is displayed

  Scenario: The control for setting the threshold for HIGH RR alarm allows setting values between 5-30 in increments of 1
    Given the user is on the alarm settings page
    When the user sets the HIGH RR alarm threshold to 5
    Then the HIGH RR alarm threshold is set to 5
    When the user sets the HIGH RR alarm threshold to 30
    Then the HIGH RR alarm threshold is set to 30
    When the user sets the HIGH RR alarm threshold to 10
    Then the HIGH RR alarm threshold is set to 10

  Scenario: GUI has a control for setting the threshold for LOW RR alarm
    Given the user is on the alarm settings page
    When the user clicks on the LOW RR alarm threshold setting
    Then the threshold setting control is displayed

  Scenario: The control for setting the threshold for LOW RR alarm allows setting values between 5-30 in increments of 1
    Given the user is on the alarm settings page
    When the user sets the LOW RR alarm threshold to 5
    Then the LOW RR alarm threshold is set to 5
    When the user sets the LOW RR alarm threshold to 30
    Then the LOW RR alarm threshold is set to 30
    When the user sets the LOW RR alarm threshold to 10
    Then the LOW RR alarm threshold is set to 10

  Scenario: GUI has a control for setting the threshold for the apnea alarm
    Given the user is on the alarm settings page
    When the user clicks on the apnea alarm threshold setting
    Then the threshold setting control is displayed

  Scenario: The control for setting the threshold for the apnea alarm allows setting values between 1-30 seconds in increments of 1
    Given the user is on the alarm settings page
    When the user sets the apnea alarm threshold to 1
    Then the apnea alarm threshold is set to 1
    When the user sets the apnea alarm threshold to 30
    Then the apnea alarm threshold is set to 30
    When the user sets the apnea alarm threshold to 10
    Then the apnea alarm threshold is set to 10

  Scenario: Alarm when relief valve opens
    Given the user is on the alarm settings page
    When the relief valve opens unexpectedly
    Then the alarm is triggered

  Scenario Outline: Threshold settings for HIGH RR alarm
    Given the user is on the alarm settings page
    When the user sets the HIGH RR alarm threshold to <threshold>
    Then the HIGH RR alarm threshold is set to <threshold>

    Examples:
      | threshold | expected |
      | 5         | 5        |
      | 10        | 10       |
      | 30        | 30       |
      | 4         | invalid  |
      | 31        | invalid  |

  Scenario Outline: Threshold settings for LOW RR alarm
    Given the user is on the alarm settings page
    When the user sets the LOW RR alarm threshold to <threshold>
    Then the LOW RR alarm threshold is set to <threshold>

    Examples:
      | threshold | expected |
      | 5         | 5        |
      | 10        | 10       |
      | 30        | 30       |
      | 4         | invalid  |
      | 31        | invalid  |

  Scenario Outline: Threshold settings for apnea alarm
    Given the user is on the alarm settings page
    When the user sets the apnea alarm threshold to <threshold>
    Then the apnea alarm threshold is set to <threshold>

    Examples:
      | threshold | expected |
      | 1         | 1        |
      | 10        | 10       |
      | 30        | 30       |
      | 0         | invalid  |
      | 31        | invalid  |
```
